about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Thomas R. Suozzi

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TAX RELIEF FOR FRAUD VICTIMS ACT
statements.title: TAX RELIEF FOR FRAUD VICTIMS ACT
sentences: According to the Federal Trade Commission, last year, 3 million American consumers reported over $15 billion in fraud losses, the highest for any year on record.
Imagine losing the money that you were saving for a down payment, the money you had built up for your kid's education, or even a savings account that helps you sleep better.

Prior to the passage of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act in 2017, victims of scams could deduct their losses from their taxes, but since then, these victims have been on the hook for hundreds of thousands of dollars in payments to the IRS despite their already precarious financial situation.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 9500, the Tax Relief for Fraud Victims Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support H.R. 9500, the Tax Relief for Fraud Victims Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RECOVER COVID UNEMPLOYMENT FRAUD IN BANKS ACT
statements.title: RECOVER COVID UNEMPLOYMENT FRAUD IN BANKS ACT
sentences: These are working families and senior citizens.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 8873, the Recover COVID Unemployment Fraud in Banks Act.
Mr. Speaker, I once again thank Representative Van Duyne for sponsoring this commonsense bill, and I urge all Members to support this legislation.

At a time when too many families face the uncertainty of unemployment, high gas and grocery prices, and seniors are forced to choose between food, rent, and healthcare, we can't allow fraudsters to get away with stealing funds meant to help hardworking families.
I urge my colleagues to support this bipartisan bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HEALTH CARE EFFICIENCY THROUGH FLEXIBILITY ACT
statements.title: HEALTH CARE EFFICIENCY THROUGH FLEXIBILITY ACT
sentences: These organizations were created under the Affordable Care Act to improve healthcare quality and to lower costs.

Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 5347, the Health Care Efficiency Through Flexibility Act, which was introduced by two of my good friends, the gentleman from Florida (Mr. Buchanan) and the gentleman from California (Mr. Panetta).
The Health Care Efficiency Through Flexibility Act received unanimous support from the members of the House Ways and Means Committee, and I urge my colleagues to support this bill on the floor today.

While Congress continues to work on other legislation to address physician payment issues and more, I urge my colleagues to support this bill that Mr. Buchanan and Mr. Panetta have worked on together in a bipartisan fashion.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EXPRESSING THE SENSE OF THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES THAT THE PRESIDENT SHOULD PRIORITIZE SECURING THE RELEASE OF PASTOR JIN MINGRI, PASTOR GAO QUANFU AND HIS WIFE
statements.title: EXPRESSING THE SENSE OF THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES THAT THE PRESIDENT SHOULD PRIORITIZE SECURING THE RELEASE OF PASTOR JIN MINGRI, PASTOR GAO QUANFU AND HIS WIFE PANG YU, DR. GULSHAN ABBAS, AND...
sentences: Madam Speaker, I rise in support of my friend Chris Smith's resolution to encourage our President while in China to push for the release of political prisoners of the Chinese Communist Party.
He and other Christian leaders in China are the victims of the Chinese Communist Party's war on faith.
I met Jimmy Lai here in our Nation's Capital in 2019 as he fought against the corruption and human rights abuses by the Chinese Communist Party.

Now we need the Chinese Communist Party to heed the message of John Lewis and so many others to respect the dignity and worth of every human being and release Dr. Gulshan Abbas, Pastor Jin Mingri, Jimmy Lai, and every other person who has been wrongfully imprisoned and to change the dynamic between our two countries.
We urge the Chinese Communist Party to stop defending the indefensible and enhance China's standing in the world by working with President Trump to finally get this done.
In anticipation of the summit, we cosponsored a bipartisan and bicameral letter with over 30 Members of the House and Senate calling for the release of Pastor Jin and other leaders of his church.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: (1420) DON'T MESS WITH MY HOME APPLIANCES ACT
statements.title: (1420) DON'T MESS WITH MY HOME APPLIANCES ACT
sentences: More efficient appliances will not only save money, but they conserve water, conserve energy, and reduce overall emissions that are killing our planet.
It simply requires that the Secretary of Energy certify that getting rid of standards such as these would not increase costs or increase greenhouse gas emissions.
I cannot vote for the proposed bill as written, and I urge my colleagues to do the same.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BREAKING THE GRIDLOCK ACT
statements.title: BREAKING THE GRIDLOCK ACT
sentences: In my district, Mr. Speaker, if you utilize the premium tax credits, a family of four making $130,000 has to pay 8\1/2\ percent of their income for health insurance premiums, or about $10,000 or $11,000 a year.
I urge all of my colleagues to vote ``yes.''

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HEALTHCARE CRISIS
statements.title: HEALTHCARE CRISIS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, there are so many issues in our country right now that are affecting our people, but one of the biggest concerns is an urgent matter that on December 31 of this year, premiums for people's health insurance are going to be skyrocketing because of the expiration of the premium tax credits.
In my district, if you are a family of four and make $130,000 a year, right now under the premium tax credits you have to pay 8.5 percent of your income for your health insurance.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COMMEMORATING KAZAKHSTAN'S REPUBLIC DAY
statements.title: COMMEMORATING KAZAKHSTAN'S REPUBLIC DAY
sentences: As we mark Kazakhstan's national holiday, we reaffirm our commitment to deepening cooperation between our two nations to meet global challenges and advance peace, security, and prosperity.
Kazakhstan's commitment to transparency, the rule of law, and an open investment climate has made it a magnet for American business.
Kazakhstan is taking bold steps to position itself as a key Eurasian transit hub.

The United States and Kazakhstan are working together to build a reliable and diversified supply chain for rare earth elements and other critical materials essential to major U.S. industries, including aerospace, defense, clean energy, and semiconductors.

Rare-earth minerals from Kazakhstan can help power the next generation of U.S. innovation, driving the transformation of the American economy built around AI, advanced manufacturing, and nuclear energy.
The Tengizchevroil venture--operated by Chevron represents Central Asia's largest oil development, ensuring reliable supply and creating thousands of high-skilled jobs.
As such, it is time for the United States to grant Kazakhstan Permanent Normal Trade Relations (PNTR) by repealing the outdated Jackson-Vanik Amendment.

We urge the Administration to seize this moment, build on the foundation of trust and shared interests, and work with Congress to achieve outcomes that advance stability, prosperity, and lasting friendship across our nations.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REPUBLICAN TAX CUTS
statements.title: REPUBLICAN TAX CUTS
sentences: The Federal Government was funded by tariffs, quite frankly, a very interesting topic for today.
Our taxes are higher in our States because we pay our teachers, police officers, firefighters, and other public workers in public employee unions and other union workers higher wages.
They don't like unions in Florida, Texas, and other low-tax States.

It is very different from State to State in our country, but in my State, for example, and in Mr. Thompson's State, similarly, if you have a teacher and a police officer who are married, their income could be over $150,000, $200,000 a year.
We will put a deduction in place that says you can deduct your State and local taxes from your income, so you don't have to pay taxes on the taxes you have already paid.
We are going to tax you on the money you have already paid in taxes at the State and local levels.
